category: SURFACE K: frozen build-3 client contract (MYEZ 1.0.0 (3), built from main 683f56c0)

findings.title: (1) Every response field the client reads from compare responses (text REST, URL, camera, history re-open) — all four paths render through the same ResultsScreen/ResultsContent tree

evidence.note: isNewFormat = !!result.overview.winner; products = result.overview.products ?? result.products ?? History re-open: GET /comparisons/{id} reads wrapper.comparison.full_response (falsy -> synthetic 404 -> 'Comparison not found') and wrapper.comparison.id (spread as comparison_id)

It does NOT carry category_profile, category, review_praise or rating_count (those exist only on the legacy result.products alias at 2172-2213), so the client's CategoryProfile / root-praise / category reads are dormant on fresh compares

findings.detail:
Tolerance per path (missing => what happens):
- success: true required on the text/url 200 to navigate (HomeScreen.tsx:433-439, 577-581); camera success is read only together with action.
- overview.winner: object. If removed while overview.products stays, isNewFormat flips false: specs table reads overview.products (no `specs`) -> empty, verdict reads top-level recommendation.
- overview.winner.product_index: null tolerated (crown falls to scoring_v2 overall or 0).
- overview.winner.reason / key_tradeoff: string or empty/null tolerated (empty -> blank verdict line); an object would be a React child -> crash (inferred from RN semantics, rendered at ResultsContent.tsx:413).
- overview.products: < 2 entries -> 'This one's not loading.' empty state (ResultsScreen.tsx:846-877). Per product: name (missing -> blank, share text prints 'undefined'), brand/variant optional, price optional (missing -> 'Price N/A'), image_url optional, pros/cons null tolerated but must be arrays if present.
- reviews.products / specs.products / specs.specs_comparison: all optional (sections fall back or show calm empty copy).
- scoring_v2: optional; when truthy it decides the crown.
- metadata: optional; only metadata.partial is read.
- comparison: optional; only comparison.error is read.
- comparison_id: optional; it gates the share sheet.
- cohort_summary: optional.
- The legacy top-level `products`, `winner_index` and `recommendation` are read only when overview.winner is absent.
- Camera 200: data.action, data.success, data.code, data.result ?? data (ResultsScreen.tsx:301-353).

findings.title: (2) SSE events and payload fields consumed — the whole stream path is compiled OFF in build 3

evidence.note: ENABLE_EXPO_FETCH_SSE_DEFAULT = false; build 3 issues only GET /api/v1/text/compare and never opens /text/compare/stream (no OTA before approval)

Parser: frames split on blank line, takes `event: X` and only the LAST `data: ` line; unknown event names and malformed JSON silently ignored. status -> onStatus(parsed.message || parsed); specs, prices, reviews, scores, verdict, first_paint, settle_update, confidence_upgrade -> pass-through callbacks; complete and settle_complete -> dispatchTerminal (first wins; success===false -> onError with code = parsed.code || parsed.metadata.code, error = parsed.error, status 503); error -> onError {code, error, layer}, status 503

HomeScreen subscribes only to onStatus (renders message, String(obj) if not a string -> '[object Object]'), onSpecs/onPrices (payload ignored, TTFB mark), onComplete, onError; reviews/scores/verdict/first_paint/settle_update/confidence_upgrade/settle_complete have no subscriber
Backend status messages are English ('Parsing query...', 'Generating verdict...'); they would render as-is if SSE were ever flipped on for this binary

findings.detail: Rules for the dormant path: new SSE event names are safe (ignored); payloads must stay single-line JSON on one `data:` line; the terminal pair must keep carrying the full ComparisonResult; `status` must keep a string `message`.

findings.title: (3) Error code / HTTP status -> copy map (what each code renders today)

evidence.note: parseApiError: code = data.code || data.detail.code; TIMEOUT / STREAM_TIMEOUT / (503 with NO code) / no-response ECONNABORTED, ETIMEDOUT, ERR_NETWORK -> 'TIMEOUT'; codeless 502/504 -> 'GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE'; retry_after_seconds (positive int) forwarded

Engine codes LLM_UNAVAILABLE / INTERNAL_ERROR / SERVER_ERROR / GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE -> title 'One moment — the comparison engine is resting' + 'Comparisons are paused for a moment. Please come back shortly.'; INSUFFICIENT_DATA -> 'Thin data on that pair — swap in two products with brand and model.'; RATE_LIMITED -> 'Plenty of compares in flight — give it {{count}} seconds, then tap.'; TIMEOUT -> 'Still gathering prices — give it another tap in a moment.'; EVERY other code incl. null, BAD_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, FEATURE_DISABLED, AUTH_REQUIRED and any NEW code -> 'Sharper match coming up — try with brand or model.' under title 'Hold on — give it another tap.'; settings surfaces: RATE_LIMITED / ACCOUNT_LOCKED else caller fallback

Text and URL: CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE -> 'We don't compare this category' / 'Try a different product — MYEZ works best with everyday shopping items.' + compare_entry_content_block{mode, layer}; USAGE_LIMIT (429, detail.code or code) -> Paywall with initialUsage; TIMEOUT -> common.error + home.errors.timeout; else the errorCopy map
REST 200 with success:false is converted to an onError carrying ONLY {code, error}; `layer` is dropped, so CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE on GET logs layer 'unknown'

Camera: 200 comparison_failed or comparison+success:false with an outage code -> engine state (Back); comparison+success:false TIMEOUT -> timeout state; other codes -> generic 'No comparison loaded' + 'Back to history'; comparison_failed with ANY other code (INSUFFICIENT_DATA, CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE, TIMEOUT) -> 'Still gathering prices' + 'Tap to retry' (re-sends the photos); need_second_product (any code, incl. CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE) -> 'We spotted one product...'; action error/other -> 'Snap each product in its own photo...'. Thrown: USAGE_LIMIT -> Paywall; 5xx except bare 503, or outage code -> engine; 429 -> timeout; 404 -> 'Comparison not found'; 401 -> 'Sign In Required' + Sign In; TIMEOUT/503/no response -> timeout; else generic
classifyLoadFailure matrix; camera outage predicates; classifyUnsuccessfulCameraComparison

An HTTPException without a structured code gets STATUS_CODE_MAP: 400 BAD_REQUEST, 404 NOT_FOUND, 503 FEATURE_DISABLED. A codeless 503 therefore reaches the client WITH code FEATURE_DISABLED, so it is NOT normalised to TIMEOUT and renders the 'Sharper match' retype nudge
URL `<2 products` exit = HTTPException(400, detail string) -> code BAD_REQUEST -> 'Sharper match coming up — try with brand or model.' (the V02 retry dialog path for two homepage links)

findings.detail:
For other endpoints:
- History list: 401 -> sign-in state; other errors -> inline retry (HistoryScreen.tsx:697-708).
- Share sheet: any error -> referrals.share.error.generic (ShareBottomSheet.tsx:209-213).
- Feedback and events: errors swallowed (FeedbackCard.tsx:57-59, api.ts:1004-1006).
- Usage status: an error returns null, and the gate falls back to the local `used < 3` (useComparisonCounter.ts:225-239).
- EditProfile: only result.success is read; false or throw -> editProfile.error.saveFailed (EditProfileScreen.tsx:106-115).
- 401 on axios calls: one shared refresh, then one retry (api.ts:225-249).
- 401 on camera identify: one refresh + one retry inline (api.ts:318-331).

findings.title: (4) Request fields the build-3 client sends

evidence.note: GET /api/v1/text/compare: product_a, product_b (trimmed), region='bahrain', selected_category ONLY when a chip is chosen, nocache never set by HomeScreen, lang='ar' ONLY when i18next.language starts with 'ar' (omitted for English), Authorization Bearer, 35 s timeout
POST /api/v1/url/compare body {url1, url2, region:'bahrain', selected_category?} — NO lang, 35 s timeout, AbortController
POST /api/v1/image/identify?region=bahrain multipart field `images` (each re-encoded JPEG width 1024, quality 0.8, named product_N.jpg) — NO lang, 120 s deadline
selected_category values: electronics, grocery, supplements, makeup, skincare, haircare, fragrances, fashion, other (plus any trending-tag string through HomeScreen.tsx:1134-1136)

GET /comparisons/history?limit=50&offset=0&search?; DELETE /comparisons/{id}; POST /feedback {useful:true, comparison_id?, mattered_most:[accurate|detailed|fast]}; POST /events {events:[{event_type, event_data, comparison_id?}]}; PUT /auth/profile {display_name}
POST /api/v1/referrals/share {comparison_id, share_target, device_fingerprint_hash, privacy:{show_name, show_result, show_reasons}}
X-Device-Fingerprint is sent ONLY on register and the two social-login POSTs, never on compare, usage or history calls
URLCompareRequest has no lang; image_routes has no lang/output_lang either. Only text_routes GET/POST accept lang (text_routes.py:377, 784, 967)

findings.detail:
Consequences for fixes:
- A backend change that localizes prose cannot rely on `lang` for URL or camera compares in build 3. It must infer the language server-side, for example from users.demographics/preferences language or the Accept-Language header. iOS NSURLSession attaching Accept-Language automatically is inferred, not verified.
- No client-side identity confirmation step exists, so audit 6.1's user_confirm step cannot happen inside build 3.

findings.title: (5a) Crash-class type constraints: fields whose removal or type change throws during render

evidence.note: A leg is filtered only on `!== undefined`; null or any string outside strong|acceptable|weak reaches `const { dot, wordKey } = LEVEL_MAP[level]` -> TypeError. A leg must be OMITTED, never null or 'unknown'
Today the backend only emits strong/acceptable/weak, so this is latent; an audit fix adding an 'unknown/no-data' leg (MYEZ-011) would crash the Results screen
scoring_v2.personalization.applied_shifts[].dim_display.replace(...) -> must be a string
(p.pros ?? []).map / (p.cons ?? []).map -> null ok, a non-array truthy value throws
safeDelta: (deltaText ?? '').trim() -> a non-string truthy delta_text throws (called from DimensionBars.tsx:288 and RunnerUpWinsCard)
item.product_names ?? [] then .filter -> a non-array truthy value throws; category.toUpperCase() -> a non-string truthy category throws

Camera: setResult(data.result ?? data) — ADDING a top-level `result` key to the /image/identify 200 body would make the client render that key instead of the comparison (an 'additive' change that breaks)

findings.detail:
Lower-grade but still visible:
- ProductImage only accepts a non-empty string. A non-string image_url falls back to the placeholder (ProductImage.tsx:59-62).
- An object-typed overview.winner.reason would be rendered as a Text child, which React Native rejects. Inferred, not measured.

findings.title: (5b) A 'no winner' result cannot be rendered by build 3 on a success payload; how winner_index null, ties and a new status render today

evidence.note: presentationWinnerIndex always resolves to 0 or 1: from scoring_v2.overall_score when scoring_v2 is truthy (winner_index is IGNORED), else winner_index===1 ? 1 : 0. null/undefined winner_index => 0; an exact overall tie => 0 (>=)

TopMatchBadge ('Top match' / 'الأفضل تطابقاً') is unconditional; the winner card always gets the emerald border/background and the scale spring. This is why V03 shows the 69.500 card green over 65.000: the green is the crown styling, not a price signal
Per-row paint: a score tie goes to the overall winner, so a 'Comparable' row (V07) still paints one side emerald
Backend docstring: 'the phones crown from' the nudged overall_score pair; the builder nudges the loser so argmax == winner_index

The text-only share for a fresh result hard-codes English 'Comparing A vs B

Winner: X

{reason}', so a no-winner result would still be shared as 'Winner:'

History row with winner_index null: no winner highlight, but BOTH tiles read runner_up_image_url first (isAWinner and isBWinner both false). Latent today because history_routes.py:73-74 returns (None, None) when winner_index is not 0|1
The list winner_index is derived from full_response.metadata.winner_index or comparison.winner_index

findings.detail:
How build 3 renders each candidate change:
- A new `status`, `result_status`, `outcome` or `winner: null` field: ignored. Grep finds no reader; the only `.status` read in the app is /health at api.ts:501.
- winner_index null at top level or overview.winner.product_index null: still crowned (by scoring_v2.overall_score, else product 0) and still 'Top match'.
- comparison_quality 'weird': hides only the RevealBurst particles (ResultsContent.tsx:462-469).
- comparison.error truthy (degraded): hides verdict and pros/cons and shows 'The detailed write-up is unavailable this time. The scores and prices below are real.' The crown stays.

The only build-3 shapes that avoid a crowned winner:
- Text: 400 with code INSUFFICIENT_DATA (alert 'Thin data on that pair...'; AR 'البيانات قليلة عن هذا الزوج — جرّب منتجين مع اسم العلامة والطراز.'). No Results screen.
- URL: the same through _surface_comparison_failure.
- Camera:
  - action 'error' (vision_failed: 'Snap each product in its own photo...');
  - 'need_second_product' ('We spotted one product...');
  - comparison_failed. With ENABLE_CAMERA_FAILURE_ENVELOPE ON in prod (CLAUDE.md:462), INSUFFICIENT_DATA arrives as comparison_failed and renders 'Still gathering prices' + 'Tap to retry', which misleads and re-sends the photos.

findings.title: (5c) Echoing comparison_id on fresh compares (ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO) would change Share behaviour described to App Review

evidence.note: comparisonId = result.comparison_id ?? route param. Absent -> text-only Share.share. Present -> the referral ShareBottomSheet, plus the id is attached to every event and the feedback row
With ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO ON, GET/POST /text/compare add result['comparison_id'] (null on a persist timeout)
The resubmission text says Share sends a text summary of a new result, and a link plus invite code only from History
Flag default OFF; a session-76 state doc says 'Stay OFF: ... ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO'

findings.detail: Keep the echo OFF while build 3 is in review. A null comparison_id is falsy and keeps the text-only path, so the key-present/null shape is harmless. A non-null id is a visible behaviour change.

findings.title: (5d) scoring_v2 null or {} and the honest-partial flag render an empty 'why' block, an empty card, or a forced crown

evidence.note: scoring_v2 = {} when < 2 products; None when ENABLE_HONEST_PARTIAL_SCORING is ON for a partial without an overall, in which case reason / key_tradeoff / recommendation are blanked

With scoring_v2 null and reason '' the verdict renders an empty Text. `!scoring_v2 && scoring` renders an EMPTY bordered card (styles.section) between the cohort slot and the accordion. No bars, no pills, no chip
scoring_v2 = {} is truthy in JS, so the crown is (undefined ?? 0) >= (undefined ?? 0) -> always product 0, overriding winner_index
The ENABLE_HONEST_PARTIAL_SCORING row says to flip it only after the FE copy row; its production state is not recorded in the S78-S80 ledgers (S78 COMPARE_QUALITY_PLAN lists it as unknown)

findings.detail:
V03 (both images missing, 'لماذا اخترنا هذا' empty, no bars or pills, specs sub without a count) matches a payload with no renderable scoring_v2 dimensions, no factual_verdict and an empty reason.

The partial note is absent in V03, so the honest-partial branch is not proven to be the cause. That part is inferred.

findings.title: (5e) Verdict precedence and localization: the client renders backend prose verbatim and English templates win over the localized reason

evidence.note: If scoring_v2.factual_verdict.line1 is truthy, FactualVerdict renders INSTEAD of overview.winner.reason (the only LLM text that receives output_lang)

An English banned word (best, pick, better, winner, good, choose, ...) or score internals in line1/line2 returns a zero-size node, so the 'why' block is blank and the reason is not shown either. The Arabic text is not checked by this English-only regex
line1/line2 are English f-strings ('{winner} leads on {label}.', '{runner} pulls ahead on {label}.', 'edges ahead despite slightly lower reviews') with no language input
_CONDITIONAL_OPENER = {'en': 'If you want', 'ar': 'If you want'}
The dimension LABEL is localized via results.dimension.<key> (51 keys in en and ar, with the backend label as fallback). delta_text renders verbatim apart from the point-math guard

Arabic labels (الطابع, الثبات) next to English delta_text ('More distinctive', 'Longer-lasting'), English factual lines and English runner-up prose. V07 (69e9e3fb-image.png) shows English 'Comparable' and 'The other product offers better durability.'
applied_shifts dim_display is rendered raw (underscores replaced only), so it is not localized client-side
key_tradeoff prose is rendered verbatim unless it matches SCORE_INTERNALS_RE (banned words are not checked here)

findings.title: (5f) Images and product info: only overview.products[i] is read; the legacy alias is dead for new-format results

evidence.note: products = overview.products ?? products; every child component receives this resolved list
image_url is projected onto overview.products; category_profile, review_praise and rating_count are written ONLY onto the result.products alias, which build 3 does not render when overview exists

Any non-empty string is passed to <Image uri>; onError falls back to the placeholder; no retry. http:// URLs are likely blocked by iOS ATS (no NSAppTransportSecurity override in app.json; inferred from Expo defaults)
History list image URLs come from full_response.products[*].image_url (the legacy alias in the persisted row) and accept http or https
The 'At a glance' section (CategoryProfile) shows only if a rendered product has category_profile.fields; it is dormant on fresh compares today

findings.detail:
Image and product-info fixes that build 3 will display:
- set overview.products[i].image_url to an absolute https raster URL (and the alias too, for History);
- adding overview.products[i].category_profile is additive but LIGHTS UP a section reviewers have not seen. That is the owner's call during review.

Re-opening from History renders the persisted full_response with the same rules. Old rows keep their old images.

findings.title: (5g) Dimension rendering rules a scoring or category fix must respect

evidence.note: Any renderable dim with score <= 0 replaces ALL bars with the visible English text 'Dimension scored 0 — backend contract breach.' Use null (silent omission) or caption_key 'limited_data' (dropped), never 0
Bars render only if scoring_v2.dimensions.length >= 3 (the RAW length, before filtering); price and value dims are removed when any price.unavailable is true
data_insufficient: true -> a 'Limited data' row (localized); more than 4 renderable dims -> a 'See full breakdown' expander
The backend Dimension model types score_a/score_b as int and confidence as a high/medium/low literal; the per-dim `winner` field the client prefers is not emitted (dormant read)
Uncatalogued key -> backend label

findings.detail:
The V06 and V07 category mismatch (beard oil showing Projection/Character, a shirt showing Heritage/Durability) is fixed entirely by WHICH keys the backend emits. The client branches on no category.

Fewer than 3 dims hides the bars entirely. That is an acceptable additive way to suppress meaningless metrics for an unsupported category.

findings.title: Non-compare endpoints read by build 3: /usage/status, /comparisons history, share, feedback, events, profile

evidence.note: /usage/status: tier ('premium' bypass), used.lifetime (number required to hydrate), limits.lifetime_free, remaining.daily + remaining.monthly (numbers required for the backend-axes gate, else `used < 3`), remaining.lifetime_free
remaining.daily/monthly (0 -> daily/monthly state), used.daily/monthly, limits.daily/monthly; 429 fallback reads initialUsage.reason, error suffix '(daily_limit)'/'(monthly_limit)', remaining

data.comparisons[] {id, query, product_names[], input_type, winner_index 0|1|null, created_at, category?, verdict_short?, winner_image_url?, runner_up_image_url?, full_response? (fallback only)}; data.total
/referrals/share response: share_link string REQUIRED (`.match` on undefined -> caught -> generic error), ?ref= code parsed from it; lifetime_invites_remaining optional (ResultsScreen.tsx:556)
shareComparison (POST /api/v1/share/{id}) and compareTextPair (POST /text/compare) are defined but never called by build 3; POST /share/{id} is not part of build 3's compare/share flow
/feedback and /events responses are never read

findings.detail: Older binaries (build 2 on TestFlight, Expo Go) may still call /share/{id} or other endpoints. I did not check this. Keep those endpoints backward compatible.

recommendations: ADDITIVE-ONLY RULE 1: Never remove, rename or retype any path listed in finding (1). Strings stay strings, arrays stay arrays, numbers stay numbers. `success` stays a boolean and still means 'navigate to Results'. overview.winner stays an object, and overview.products stays an array of >= 2 entries on success.

RULE 2 (crash class): scoring_v2.confidence_legs.<leg> must be one of strong|acceptable|weak or the key must be OMITTED (never null, never a new word). applied_shifts[].dim_display and every dims[].delta_text must be strings. pros/cons must be arrays. History product_names must be an array and category a string or null. Never add a top-level `result` key to the /image/identify 200 body.

RULE 3 (no-winner): build 3 cannot render 'no winner' on a success payload, and a new status/result_status field is ignored. Under review, send identity or data refusals as text/URL 400 with code INSUFFICIENT_DATA (raised through _surface_comparison_failure so the code survives). For the camera, use action 'error' (unidentified) or 'need_second_product'. Never send winner_index null on success expecting a neutral render. Put any new status field behind a dark flag for build 4.

RULE 4 (codes): use only codes build 3 maps: INSUFFICIENT_DATA, TIMEOUT, STREAM_TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED, LLM_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR, SERVER_ERROR, USAGE_LIMIT, CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE. Any new code renders 'Sharper match coming up — try with brand or model.' Never raise a 503 without an explicit code: error_handler turns it into FEATURE_DISABLED, which is NOT treated as a timeout. A CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE on a homepage URL would say 'We don't compare this category', which is wrong for MYEZ-005/006; INSUFFICIENT_DATA is the closest existing copy.

RULE 5 (scores): never emit a dimension score of 0; use null or caption_key 'limited_data'. Keep dimension keys inside the 51-key results.dimension.* catalog. Sending fewer than 3 dimensions is a safe additive way to hide meaningless bars for an unsupported category.

RULE 6 (localization): localize server-side by VALUE only (factual_verdict line1/line2, delta_text, key_tradeoff, reason, applied_shifts.dim_display, category_profile labels). Build 3 sends `lang` only on GET /text/compare, so the URL and camera paths need server-side language resolution (stored user language or Accept-Language), behind a dark flag. Keep localized factual lines free of the English banned words and score internals, or the 'why' block goes blank.

RULE 7 (images/product info): write image_url to overview.products[i] as an absolute https raster URL; the legacy result.products alias is unread for new-format results (it only feeds History thumbnails). Adding category_profile to overview.products lights up the dormant 'At a glance' section: additive, but a visible change and therefore the owner's call during review.

RULE 8 (flags to keep OFF until build 3 is approved or the owner rules): ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO (changes Share from the text summary described in the Review Notes to the referral sheet), ENABLE_HONEST_PARTIAL_SCORING (blank 'why' block plus an empty legacy card), and any flag that can make scoring_v2 = {} or leave `scoring` present while scoring_v2 is null.

RULE 9 (camera): with ENABLE_CAMERA_FAILURE_ENVELOPE ON, a comparison_failed carrying INSUFFICIENT_DATA renders 'Still gathering prices' + 'Tap to retry', which re-sends the photos. If a fix starts refusing more camera compares, prefer action 'error' (refunded non-delivery) over comparison_failed for identity failures.

RULE 10 (History): if a fix ever stores a null winner_index, keep winner_image_url and runner_up_image_url both null for that row (history_routes already does this). The build-3 row reads runner_up_image_url for BOTH tiles when winner_index is null.

Client-side items that need build 4 (cannot be fixed by the backend): the unconditional 'Top match' badge and winner styling; the English share text 'Winner:'; the FactualVerdict-over-reason precedence; the per-row tie paint; the empty legacy-scoring card; the history null-winner image mapping; URL and camera requests missing `lang`; the green tick on any http(s) URL (TwoInputShell.tsx:250-255).
open_questions: What are the production values of ENABLE_HONEST_PARTIAL_SCORING and ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO? The CLAUDE.md rows do not state them. A session-76 doc says to keep the echo OFF, and the S78 COMPARE_QUALITY_PLAN lists honest-partial as unknown.

Does iOS NSURLSession attach Accept-Language to build 3's axios and fetch calls, and does it follow the in-app language or only the device language? This decides whether URL and camera prose can be localized without a client change.
Does the built Info.plist of 1.0.0 (3) block http:// image URLs (ATS)? If so, the backend must upgrade or drop http image_url values (history_routes._safe_image_url accepts http).

Is the V03 empty 'why' block a scrubbed reason (metadata.verdict_scrubbed), a missing factual_verdict, or honest-partial? The screenshot alone cannot tell. The persisted full_response of that comparison would settle it.
Do any build-2 or older binaries remain in testers' hands that call POST /api/v1/share/{id} or the SSE stream? Their contract was not audited here.
